mechanics.claim: Null Sphere is a unit-targeted projectile (speed 1400) rather than an instant hit; the cast time is separate from its travel time to the target.
Casting Null Sphere also disrupts the target's ongoing channel, a crowd-control effect a stationary, non-casting dummy never triggers.
Kassadin also gains a magic damage shield lasting 1.5s, granted at the start of the cast time; the dummy never attacks back so the shield never absorbs anything.
mechanics.quote: The shield is granted at the start of the cast time.
